description: Ingest Lag Profiler: split a data stream name (type-dataset-namespace) into the fields the miss-rate query joins on. A name that doesn't fit is kept with lagprof.parse_error and never joins, so one odd name can't fail a whole workflow run.

script.source: if (ctx.data_stream.namespace.contains('-')) { throw new IllegalArgumentException('data stream name has more than three parts: ' + ctx.data_stream.name); }
